card.name: Digits inside citation numbers and codes
card.fires_on: Single digits within reference numbers, such as scripture verse numbers, Catholic Encyclopedia URL codes, report numbers and NDC codes. It fires on the digit itself, often partway through a number.

modes.label: Scripture verse numbers
modes.description: A chapter or verse digit in a Bible or scripture citation.
modes.example: 1 John 2:19; 1 John 4:3; 2 John <<7>>. Now this clears the ground at once

modes.label: Digits in URLs and codes
modes.description: A digit inside an encyclopedia URL code, a report number or a drug NDC code.

card.plain: It marks a digit inside a reference number, such as a Bible verse, web address code or product code.
